name: Retraining
summary: Between missions, the GM may allow a character to retrain one proficiency, Talent, psychic power or comparable choice when the fiction supports training, reconditioning, recovered memory, doctrinal change or a new mentor. Retraining is not intended to become free respec after every mission.
